story.title: Man Charged with Stabbing Met Police Officer During Raid
story.summary: A man has been charged with stabbing a Metropolitan Police officer during an early morning raid on a suspected organized crime group. The incident occurred on Tuesday as part of the police operation.

explore_lenses.label: How did the investigation reach this point?
explore_lenses.title: Months of joint work led to the raids
explore_lenses.summary: Police say the operation followed a lengthy inquiry involving the Met, HMRC and the FCA. The officer was injured while executing one of the warrants in Cockfosters on September 29, 2026.

claims.text: The Met says a police officer was stabbed in the leg while executing a warrant in Cockfosters, Barnet, and that the injury was assessed as non-life-changing; the officer was taken to hospital.
Charles Charalambous, 56, was charged with wounding with intent to cause GBH to resist arrest in connection with the stabbing, according to the Met.
HMRC said the operation illustrated the importance of collaboration with other law-enforcement partners in tackling suspected money laundering and other serious organized crime.

story_report.summary: A 56-year-old man has been charged after a Metropolitan Police officer was stabbed in the leg while officers executed a warrant during a Tuesday raid targeting organised crime in Cockfosters, Barnet. Police said the officer was taken to hospital with an injury assessed as non-life-changing. The charge is the immediate criminal consequence of the incident during the early-morning operation.

sections.heading: Organised Crime Raid Context
sections.body: The warrant was part of an operation directed at suspected organised crime. HMRC said joint work with other law-enforcement partners was important in tackling suspected money laundering and other serious organised crime.

sections.heading: Charge Against Charles Charalambous
sections.body: The Met identified the defendant as Charles Charalambous, 56. It said he was charged with wounding with intent to cause GBH to resist arrest in connection with the officer’s stabbing.

unresolved.text: Public accounts have not described what occurred inside the address, the evidence supporting the charge, or Charalambous’s response to it.

related_stories.title: Co-Pilot Attempts to Crash Flydubai Flight After Stabbing Pilot
related_stories.summary: An incident occurred on a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv when a co-pilot stabbed the pilot and attempted to crash the plane. Passengers intervened, subduing the co-pilot, allowing the flight to be safely diverted to Saudi Arabia. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed that most passengers were Israeli nationals and described the situation as a potential terror attack.

related_stories.title: South Africa's President Calls for Men's Responsibility in Addressing Gender-Based Violence
related_stories.summary: In response to a recent surge in femicides, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa has urged men to take responsibility for gender-based violence. He announced measures aimed at better protecting women, including a review of unsolved murders and serious sexual offenses against women and children. The call for action comes amid public anger towards authorities for their handling of these cases.

related_stories.title: Federal Court Issues Stay on Christa Pike's Execution
related_stories.summary: A federal appeals court has temporarily halted the execution of Christa Pike, who has been on death row for over two decades for a murder committed at age 18. The stay was issued just hours before her scheduled execution, allowing the court to review whether Pike's claims of childhood sexual abuse were adequately considered during her sentencing.
